About AI usage
The store page AI disclosure says the following -
"We leverage AI technology in certain tasks to achieve higher-quality results. AI is used primarily for handling repetitive tasks or as a tool for quality enhancement, while the core content and final outputs are crafted by skilled professionals."
Could we get a specific example of this?

Jun 10, 2025 @ 2:56am

played a bit of the demo but,

- the video after the end of day 1 is obviously AI
- every background is obviously AI with touch up edits, everything just blends and blur together, you can look and see hundreds of items but no details on any of them, furthermore no item make any logistical sense being where they were, the placements are all whack

some tells based on patterns that only AI uses, that i encountered:
- translation is pretty obviously AI, some points they use "him" to refer to a female, a pretty obvious tell of MTL; and lot of time they use the phrase "reception my quest" which i have never heard anyone speaks like that; and generally dialogues that just sound weird.
- from the small stories/info on day 2 that you gather from the adventurers, an obsessive overuse of quotations, where a normal writer would just write and describes things normally
- also from those small stories from day 2, the most obvious tell of AI generated scripts, em dashes, a lot of them too, sometime in the same paragraph with regular hyphen/dash. generative AIs love using that symbol for some reason. and the overuse of it in the texts in this game, doesn't look too good

So from what im seeing, they are using AI for the backgrounds, script/dialogue writing, translations. Personally as someone who is interested in visual novels, the AI generated scripts/dialogue and translation is especially bad to see.

all that said, it could be a fun concept of a game, would love for a dev to elaborate on the AI usage in this game
